proposal.change: Replace input-dependent value-embedding gates with the fixed addition v = v + ve. Remove ve_gate modules and their initialization while retaining value embeddings.
proposal.mechanism: Speculative gain: removing small gate projections, sigmoid operations, and associated optimizer work may increase training throughput. The fixed gate matches its initialized value of one.
proposal.diagnostic: Compare timed steps, tokens processed, and development val_bpb against the baseline under the unchanged training budget.
proposal.falsifier: Reject if development val_bpb does not improve by at least 0.003, or removing adaptive gating harms convergence despite improved throughput.
evidence: train.py: GPT.init_weights initializes gate weights to zero, yielding a gate of one.
